jobs.occupation: Solutions Consultant with Icelandic and English
jobs.description:
Solutions Consultant with Icelandic and English
  * Please note that the position is based in Sofia, Bulgaria, and we will assist you to relocate.
  Escape the Ordinary: 6-Month Adventure as a Solutions Consultant with Icelandic & English in Sofia! ✈
  Are you looking for a fresh start, a career boost, or simply an unforgettable experience in one of Eastern Europe's most vibrant cities? Join TELUS Digital Bulgaria for an exciting 6 month journey as a Solutions Consultant for the world's biggest search engine.
  This isn't just a job—it's a half year immersion into a dynamic, international environment where you can grow professionally while exploring the beauty of Bulgaria.
 And the best part? If you love the vibe and the work, there is the possibility to extend your stay and build a long-term career with us!
  Why this is your perfect next step: We’ve made sure your transition to Sofia is as smooth as possible, so you can focus on the experience: 
  Instant Home: 21 days of company provided accommodation on arrival, plus full support in finding your perfect short-term apartment.
 Flight Tickets Covered: We fly you to Sofia; you bring the energy!
 Fully Paid Training: Get up to speed quickly with our world-class onboarding.
 The "Sofia Perk": Live in a city known for its stunning mountains, rich culture, and affordable cost of living.
 Comprehensive Benefits: Access to additional health insurance and over fifty benefits and services to make your time in Sofia unforgettable.
 Global Networking: Work in a positive international environment and make friends from all over the world.
  
 
 Your Mission (for the next 6 months and beyond): 
  Deliver professional support for our products and services, ensuring our users have a stellar experience.
 Master CRM software and ticketing systems to solve puzzles and help people every day.
 Engage with customers across multiple channels: phone, email, and chat.
 Meet performance goals (SLAs) while utilizing our comprehensive knowledge base.
 Collaborate with a high-energy team to share best practices and grow together.
  
 
 What You'll Need:
  Fluent Icelandic and English communication skills (essential).
 A customer-first mindset and strong interpersonal abilities.
 The ability to follow structured guides while remaining a creative problem-solver.
 Active listening skills and an adaptable nature.
 Self-motivation and a passion for helping others.
  
 
 The Ideal Candidate Profile: You are someone who embraces change, learns quickly, and is excited by the prospect of living and working in a new country. Whether you are between degrees, taking a career break, or seeking a professional challenge in a new setting—you’ll fit right in.
  The best part? No tech background needed! We provide the tools and the training; you provide the enthusiasm. Our intensive program will equip you with everything you need to succeed from day one. 
 Ready for the adventure of a lifetime? APPLY NOW!
  
 About us: TELUS Digital Bulgaria is the largest employer in the CX (Customer Experience) industry in the country with over 4,500 team members. The company provides a broad portfolio of services - designing, building, and delivering next-generation digital services, AI solutions, customer experience, and more. The company's primary focus is strict adherence to all our clients' procedures and practices. We are an independent outsourcing services provider and do not function as a local representation of our partners.

jobs.occupation: English speaking personal assistant in Järfälla
jobs.employer_name: Assistans i balans i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Hello!
I am now looking for another personal assistant for my team in Järfälla, north of Stockholm.

I have a physical limitation which means that you will need to assist me with most things in my everyday life such as house chores, cooking and personal hygiene. I do guide my assistants through verbal communication in both Swedish and English.

Your workplace will mostly be in my home as I spend a lot of my time home, but sometimes I go out on errands in the company of my assistants.
Sometimes I go and train in the pool in the swimming hall therefore some water experience is required so you can assist me in the pool. Ability to swim is not a requirement.

I’m looking for a person who is both mentally and physically strong since the work is very challenging both physically and mentally. You will need to assist me with manual transfers as well when the need arises.

It is a requirement that you speak and understand English at least at a conversational level to understand and be able to communicate in English , as the introduction will be in English.

Qualities that I expect you to possess are high work ethics, flexibility regarding working hours and tasks, that you are positive, passionate about personal assistant work and that you see the employment as long-term as I hope that we will work together for a longer time.

It is a requirement that you are a non-smoking woman aged 30-55 years. It is not a requirement that you are a Swedish speaker, for me it is fine if we speak English as well. If you are not yet a Swedish citizen, you need to have a residence and work permit for the employment. The information you give us about your work permit and residence will be followed up with Immigration for safety reasons.

I am looking for someone who wants to work about 30 hours per week, both day, evening and night and extra if needed. En between Mars 23- April 22 you will need to work up to 40 hours a week due to semester of an employee. We are a small working group that stands in for each other in case of illness and leave. 
 
With Assistans i Balans as an employer, you are guaranteed support, personal work management, supervision, education and training so that you can act professionally, be confident and develop in an exciting job. All the courses in Assistans i Balans office are held in Swedish besides the introduction and support/mentoring we are able as a working team to provide you in English if needed.
Individual salary setting Agreement: FREMIA/KOMMUNAL
 
The responses with a picture attached to will be prioritized for the sake of just being able to attach a face with the application because of the sensitive nature of this work.

Search via the link.
Hope to see you!

jobs.occupation: English or French speaking babysitter in Lidingö
jobs.description:
Solidum Sverige AB/Barnakademin has been providing families with high-quality childcare services since 2008. We offer creative childcare in Swedish and specialize in bilingual babysitting services.

About the Position

A warm and welcoming family in Lidingö is looking for a reliable, English-speaking babysitter to care for their two children, aged 3.6 years and 2 years, two afternoons per week from approximately 15:00–18:00.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Picking up the children from preschool at approximately 15:00/16:00
• Serving a simple dinner
• Engaging the children in fun and age-appropriate activities at home, in the garden, or at the nearby playground
• Assisting with the evening routine

The family would also appreciate occasional evening babysitting, approximately every second month.

Who We're Looking For

• Part-time job seekers, ideally students with a genuine passion for childcare
• Native or fluent English or French speakers
• Candidates who are available two afternoons per week
• Responsible, caring, and creative individuals with excellent social skills
• Someone looking for a long-term commitment of at least 6 months

What We Offer

• A flexible part-time position with the opportunity to work with multiple families (3–10 hours per week)
• Competitive starting salary
• Comprehensive written references upon completion of your employment
• Ongoing support from our central office
• A friendly community of fellow babysitters

Our Commitment

We value long-term relationships and are looking for candidates who can commit for 6–12 months.

Apply Today!

If you think you'd be a great fit for this role, we'd love to hear from you! Apply in either English or Swedish, and we look forward to welcoming you to the Barnakademin family.

jobs.occupation: Teacher, English, Science, Technology, Ages 4 - 9
jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Engagerad lärare i engelska och NO 4-6 eller teknik 7-9 sökes till Internationella Engelska Skolan Karlstad.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Karlstad är en skola för årskurs 4-9 med 400 elever och 50 anställda. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska, beroende på ämne. Hos oss sätts lärande och kunskap i första rummet. Vi är en skola med en stark och tydlig värdegrund som präglas av en trygg arbetsmiljö, god ordning och mycket omtanke. Vårt mål är att eleverna ska lära sig ta ett personligt ansvar för sin utveckling och sin arbetsmiljö, samt respektera sina skolkamrater, sina lärare och sig själva.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med start 2027-01-07. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna enligt gällande kollektivavtal.

Vi söker i första hand dig som har adekvat högskoleutbildning och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i engelska och NO-ämnena eller teknik för de aktuella årskurserna. 

Din profil

- Du har svenska eller engelska som modersmål, samt goda kunskaper i båda språken för att kunna verka i vår tvåspråkiga miljö.
- Du har förmågan att utöva ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap i klassrummet.
- Du är en aktiv normsättare som kan upprätthålla den trygghet och studiero som vår skola står för. 

För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara kreativ, ansvarstagande och nytänkande. Du drivs av att ha en nära och regelbunden kontakt med vårdnadshavare. Vidare är du en lagspelare som uppskattar att samarbeta med kollegor i en stödjande och professionell miljö.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet och hur väl din pedagogiska profil matchar skolans värdegrund och arbetssätt. Ett aktuellt utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister är ett lagstadgat krav för anställning i skolan och måste uppvisas innan ett eventuellt erbjudande om anställning kan ges.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För mer information om vår skola, se www.karlstad.engelska.se Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev, lärarlegitimation samt utdrag från polisregistret till applications.karlstad@engelska.se

Märk ansökningen “Lärare i engelska och NO/teknik”.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

 Internationella Engelska Skolan Staffanstorp startades i augusti 2022 och är en F-9 skola med tillhörande fritidshem, där vi har möjligheten att följa eleverna från förskoleklass till årskurs 9. 

 IES Staffanstorp är en tvåspråkig skola. Du bör känna dig bekväm med att kommunicera med kollegor, elever och deras familjer på både svenska och engelska. Vi uppmuntrar och stödjer internationellt utbildade lärare som börjar hos oss att både lära sig svenska och komplettera sin lärarutbildning för att nå en svensk lärarlegitimation på sikt.

  Detta är du! 

Du är lärare, behörig i svenska,so och engelska åk 4-6. Du ser vikten av att skapa och behålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och vårdnadshavare. Du motiveras av att samarbeta med kollegor i en stödjande miljö. Du är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap där du kan skapa en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet. Du värdesätter och levererar ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med både kontroll och elevengagemang i fokus. Du som lärare är en tydlig och aktiv normsättare.

- ett genuint intresse för barns lärande och en passion för ditt yrke.

- en positiv inställning och bidrar till utveckling av verksamheten.

- ett professionellt förhållningssätt.

- ett flexibelt arbetssätt

- en stark övertygelse att samarbete är den självklara vägen till framgång i undervisningen.

- en varm och öppen personlighet samt förmåga att sätta gränser.

- initiativförmåga, och bedriver ett tydligt ledarskap i klassrummet.

- en förmåga att systematiskt dokumentera, analysera, utvärdera och följa upp elevernas kunskapsutveckling.

  Rekryteringssprocess 

Vi intervjuar fortlöpande för tjänsten. Skicka därför in din ansökan så snart som möjligt - vi ser fram emot att få läsa den och få chansen att prata med dig om tjänsten och dina kvalifikationer för den! Alla Internationella Engelska Skolor i landet vilar på samma grund, vårt IES Ethos. Läs gärna mer om detta och se om de stämmer överens med dina egna professionella värderingar och övertygelser.

 Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper och samarbetsförmåga. Tjänstgöringsgrad: 100%. Välkommen med din ansökan!

 Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt från rekryteringsföretag och annonssäljare.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in English with a Specialisation in Literature
jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.
 
 
Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?
 
 
Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.
 
 
The Faculty of Philosophy, conducts education and research in the humanities, social sciences and education, mathematics and natural sciences, as well as the arts. Our research and education are carried out in close dialogue with the wider community and contribute to critical knowledge development, intellectual growth, and a deeper understanding of complex societal issues. Education is offered at all levels and is grounded in scientific or artistic foundations and characterized by academic breadth. Together, we contribute to a sustainable, open, and knowledge-based society.  The Faculty comprises three departments, employing approximately 420 members of staff in total. Through our collaborative platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector, and industry to jointly advance knowledge development and address societal challenges.
 
 
The Department of Social Science and Humanities provides education in social sciences, behavioural sciences, and language and communication. Research focuses on societal issues such as democracy, migration, sustainable development and communication, and is conducted in close collaboration with the surrounding society.
Employment information
Employment: Permanent employment which begins with possible trial employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-08-01
 
Scope: Part-time 75 %
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-02
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
Department/Unit: Social Sciences and Humanities
For information and a detailed description of basic eligibility requirements and assessment criteria, that apply to a position of a senior lecturer, please consult the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalen University https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
Position description
As a senior lecturer at MDU, your main tasks are teaching. Teaching also includes supervision, examination, course evaluation and course development. At MDU, research and education are closely intertwined and research forms the basis of our programmes. Collaboration is also an integral part of our research and education mission and as a senior lecturer you will actively contribute to the university's development work.
The tasks include:
teaching and examination in literature and literature didactics on the undergraduate and graduate levels, within the primary and subject teacher programmes as well as in other contexts
teaching and examination in English proficiency courses
course coordination and other administrative tasks
supervision and examination of degree projects
participation in pedagogical, scientific and collegial development
research and contributions to the department's research environments
general administration and competence development as well as participating in the daily activities, in the work of the subject and the department
additional tasks, such as work placement visits in the teacher programmes or teaching in research education, may be included

Qualification requirements
We are looking for a person with documented teaching skills and a degree of Doctor, or equivalent academic competence.
To be qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer one must have demonstrated the academic skills and teaching abilities required for the appointment.
Teaching skills and academic competence shall be well documented in such a way that their quality can also be assessed.
In order to be employed as a teacher at MDU, training in higher education teaching and learning, or equivalent acquired knowledge, is required. A person appointed as a senior lecturer but lacking training in higher education teaching and learning will be offered in-house training within two and a half years. The course in higher education teaching and learning at Mälardalen University corresponds to ten weeks of training.
In addition to the established basic eligibility requirements, according to the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalens university, some additional requirements apply to this position.
The applicant must have a doctoral degree in English with a focus on literature or literature didactics, or in education with a focus on teaching and learning through literature in English as a foreign or second language, or in a closely related field of relevance to the position. Experience of teaching and supervision in literature and/or literature didactics is expected (within the subject of English in higher education).
Also required are an excellent knowledge of and proficiency in written and spoken English, including the ability to teach about and in the language and to communicate in it on an academic level.
 
Assessment criteria
The assessment criteria will be based partly on the degree of skill required for the position and partly on the ability and suitability otherwise required to carry out the work duties.
 
This advert is abridged. To see the full advert, please go to: 
https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
 
Application
The application is to be completed online. Please submit your application by clicking on the "Apply" button below.
The scientific publications that you do not have in digital form are to be sent by post in three copies to:
Mälardalen University
 
Division of Human Resources
 
Ref.no: 2026/2800
 
Box 883
 
SE-721 23 Västerås, SWEDEN
The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete in accordance with the advertisement and will reach the university no later than closing date for application.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: 1st Line Support Agent (English and Spanish speaking)
jobs.description:
The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.
They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their 1st line support team with a Spanish and English speaking support agent.
This position is in Linköping and you need to work from the office.

About you
● You have excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think “outside the box”.
● You possess great computing skills and are interested in all things technical.
● You provide a high level of customer service and have a full understanding of its importance.
● You are a curious and fast learner.
● You communicate clearly in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.

This is considered an entry-level position and although we don’t believe that you need specific qualifications to succeed in this role, it is very important that you are interested in tech, and have a basic understanding of computing, cloud-based services, and mobile technology.

About the position 
As a 1st line support agent, no two days will look the same.
Your daily focus will be to help our customers through phone, web chat and email.
You will help our customers solving their problems and making sure they have the correct settings on their account.
Over time, you will become an expert in the system and point of contact for anyone internally, you’ll be providing operational and technical support to teams across all of our departments.
The working hours will be normal office hours, Monday to Friday.

Your daily tasks will include
● Help the customers through phone, web chat and email, to make sure the customers can use the system the way they want it to work.
● Supporting the sales teams in sales demos and general technical support.

It will be considered an advantage if
● You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.
● You have experience in technical support, ideally in an international environment.

For this position you need to already have a Swedish work permit.

jobs.occupation: MYP International School of Karlskrona (ISK)
jobs.description:
I Karlskrona är våra ambitioner höga och vi brinner för att utveckla den moderna staden i havet. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad. Välkommen till Blekinges största arbetsgivare, där dina möjligheter att utvecklas är goda.



1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
We are currently seeking an enthusiastic MYP Teacher of Science and English Language Acquisition for a full-time temporary position of at least six months.

The role primarily involves teaching MYP students at the International School of Karlskrona, although some teaching within the PYP may also be included depending on the candidate's qualifications.

At ISK, you will teach within the Middle Years Programme and work according to IB educational methodologies. Teaching is conducted in English and is founded on inquiry-based learning, conceptual understanding, and an international perspective.

You are passionate about teaching and working with young people. You inspire students' curiosity and provide opportunities for them to grow both academically and personally. ISK has a strong collaborative culture, and you should enjoy working as part of a team and contributing to the school community as a whole.

KVALIFIKATIONER
We are looking for someone who:

· Is a certified teacher qualified to teach English, Science, or a comparable combination of subjects for Grades 7-9.

· Has completed IB teacher training and has previous IB experience.

· Can work according to the IB's inquiry-based and concept-driven educational philosophy.

· Can teach in English.

· Contributes to an international perspective in teaching.

· Can lead and organize learning effectively to create a calm and productive classroom environment.

· Builds trusting relationships with students and guides them in an inspiring manner.

· Works well collaboratively with colleagues and sees teamwork as a natural part of the profession.

· Has a good understanding of the school's governing documents and can apply them in daily practice.

Great importance will be placed on personal suitability. A background check is required prior to employment.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-11-20  Eller enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2027-06-17  .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

I Karlskrona kommun har du som medarbetare ett flertal förmåner. Några av de förmånerna är extra semesterdagar när du når en viss ålder, friskvårdsbidrag, möjligheten att gratis simma i någon av kommunens simhallar och ett riktigt bra tjänstepensionsavtal.

jobs.occupation: Operatör till valsverkstan/ Operator to Rolling Mill workshop
jobs.description:
SMS group är världsledande när det gäller framtidsinriktade teknologier och enastående service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på mer än 4 miljarder euro. Vi tillämpar våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska:
Som operatör i våra valsverkstäder kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i att säkerställa driften och effektiviteten av vår specialiserade utrustning samt leverera service och underhåll på kundens komponenter till de olika valsverken. Du kommer att arbeta med en rad olika teknikområden, vilket ger dig möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens inom bland annat maskinbearbetning, montage, kvalitetskontroller och mätteknik.
English:
As an operator in our rolling mills, you will play a key role in ensuring the operation and efficiency of our specialized equipment and delivering service and maintenance on customer components to the various rolling mills. You will work with a range of different technical areas, giving you the opportunity to use and develop your skills in areas such as machining, assembly, quality control and measurement technology.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska:
Arbetet innehåller både planerade och akuta service/underhållsåtgärder, vilket passar dig som tycker om att lösa problem och har en ”can do” inställning. Detta innebär även att du har ett öga för detaljer och en vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och processer. Det är viktigt att du trivs med att både arbeta självständigt och som en del av ett lag.
Du kan uttrycka dig väl i svenska och eller engelska då arbetet till stor del sker i samarbete med dina kollegor.
Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom maskinbearbetning, gärna inom tung industri, samt innehar en gymnasieexamen eller likvärdig utbildning.
Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av:
Arbete i en valsverkstad
Maskinbearbetning
Kvalitetskontroller och tillhörande mätinstrument
Hantering av travers/kran i verkstadsmiljö

English:
The work includes both planned and urgent service/maintenance measures, which suits you who like to solve problems and have a "can do" attitude. This also means that you have an eye for detail and a desire to constantly improve our working methods and processes. It is important that you enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
You can express yourself well in Swedish and/or English as the work is largely done in collaboration with your colleagues.
We would like you to have a background in machining, preferably in heavy industry, and hold a high school diploma or equivalent education.
Experience in:
Working in a rolling mill
Machining
Quality controls and associated measuring instruments
Handling of overhead cranes/cranes in a workshop environment is an advantage

Om SMS group/Abour SMS group
Svenska:
Med SMS group hittar du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är vad vi lovar våra kunder och anställda nu och i framtiden.
Låter detta som en intressant möjlighet? Välkommen till en arbetsplats där din utveckling är central och där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens lösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Då rekryterings teamet är internationellt önskar vi din ansökan på engelska.
English:
With SMS group you will find international career opportunities. Our values ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE and SUCCEED have always been an integral part of our work and are what we promise our customers and employees now and in the future.
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Welcome to a workplace where your development is central and where we together create tomorrow’s solutions. We look forward to receiving your application in English!
Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Låter det här som en intressant möjlighet? Ta chansen och skicka in din ansökan, CV och ett personligt brev på engelska.
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du självklart välkommen att kontakta oss. Notera att urval kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, den 31 december 2026.
Vi ser fram mot din ansökan!
English
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? If so, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026.
We look forward to receiving your application!
